item.title: Implement specified token bucket rate limiter
item.brief: Implement the rate limiter in ratelimit.py according to SPEC.md, which is authoritative. The module currently has stubs; test_ratelimit.py covers basics only, so account for every specified error case and edge case. Keep it dependency-free using only the Python standard library. Run relevant tests/checks and commit the completed change as requested. Acceptance: behavior matches SPEC.md across normal operation, boundary conditions, and errors; existing tests pass; no third-party dependencies; commit exists on the item branch.

pr.body: Implemented dependency-free continuous token refill, clock-backward clamping, validation, wait_time calculations, and per-key LRU eviction using the standard library. Expanded test_ratelimit.py for fractional refill, backward clocks, invalid inputs, LRU use/eviction, and invalid-call side effects. Checks: python -m unittest -v test_ratelimit.py (8 passed); python -m py_compile ratelimit.py test_ratelimit.py (passed); git diff --check (passed). No additional assumptions or known limitations.
